profile.headline: Software Engineer at Booz Allen Hamilton

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Completed the 3 week Modern Tech Excellence program containing in-person lectures, hands-on virtual labs, weekly assessment tests, and a main project that incorporated all of the course materials while using an agile methodology. 
- Course materials and technologies included Java, Maven, Gradle, Git, Spring Boot, Rest APIs with Spring, Docker, Kubernetes, and Jenkins.
- Contracted out to clients looking for software-related consultants

positions.title: Software Developer Trainee
positions.description:
- 16 week training course in Java Development, SQL,  HTML/CSS, and Unix
- Contracted out to companies looking for tech-related consultants (AppDynamics and Fannie Mae)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Developed an enum controller component in Java to synchronize the enumerations between accounting teams which incorporated HTTP Requests, Data Access Objects, and XML Parsing. 
- Supported automated accounting software for performing and non-performing loans in java environment including mybatis persistence, Junit testing, Spring and Object Orientation.
- Coordinated with LAI team to meet deliverables using the scrum/agile methodology. 
- Set up and supported ESB Translator for message transmission (System used to parse, publish, and consume data to and from accounting teams outside of LAI)

positions.title: Junior Consultant
positions.description:
- Worked remotely and traveled to client engagement sites to provide support, solutions, consultation and lead presentations for the Appdynamics product on the customers Java and/or .NET environments.
- Worked closely with the project managers and customer teams to ensure customer’s business needs were met during the engagements.
- Developed numerous Unix scripts to provide more specific solutions for the Appdynamics product extensions
- Increased efficiency of the training/Onboarding process for new employees by creating and developing training materials and demo’s

positions.title: Assistant to the Project Manager
positions.description:
- Monitored and recorded daily production on a $6 million exterior restoration project.
- Directed work assignments moving forward to maintain the project schedule in conjunction with the site supervisor and the project manager.

positions.title: Advanced Digital Systems Researcher
positions.description:
- Studied hardware and software components and completed projects that worked with FPGA mapping, gate level analysis, and signal testing of the BASYS 2 board using VHDL.
- Held practice sessions for 12 students in the digital systems class and created presentations to explain gate logic, sequential circuits, programmable logic devices and memory components.

positions.title: Runner
positions.description:
Collaborated with co-workers for process re-engineering of sales and created an inventory management system.
Assisted Supervisor with special projects.
 Provided excellent customer service by anticipating the needs of the customer.

projects.title: Senior Design - Capital One Android Wear Watch Application
projects.description:
- Created a notification based banking application for the Android Wear Watch using Java in Android Studio.
- Constructed and altered banking functions within the limits of the watch to ensured a more efficient process for people to interact with their bank accounts.
- Simulated bank account data using a MySQL database.
- Won third place at ECE (Electrical and Computer Engineering) day. 

Four main functions:
 - Check Balance
 - Bill Pay
 - low Balance
 - Fraud Alerts

projects.title: Video Game Project (Event Horizon)
projects.description:
- Formulated the concept and design for an escape based side scrolling space shooter. 
- Created timeline with specific tasks, assigned roles to team members, managed the process of the project.
- Coded object oriented gameplay functions and features in C#.
- Held weekly meetings to assess the work completed and moved forward with the following tasks.

organizations.name: T.R.U.S.T. (Teach, Retain, Unite in Science and Technology)
organizations.description:
- Marketed organization events for the public through social media, flyers, and communication
- Managed and modernized organization website
